record.title: Relative Expander Monotonicity and MCF with Singular Initial Data
record.statement: Let $M_0$ be a hypersurface in $\mathbb{R}^{n+1}$ with isolated point singularities modeled on regular hypercones, and let $(M_t)_{t\ge 0}$ be a mean curvature flow with initial data $M_0$. For any tangent flow $(P_t)_{t\ge 0}$ to $(M_t)_{t\ge 0}$ at a singular point $p$, one has $P_t=\sqrt{t}\,P$ for every $t>0$. The expander $P$ solves $\vec H-\frac{x^\perp}{2}=0$ for $x\in P$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/34](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/2045), page 5. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Finiteness of class numbers for affine algebraic groups in characteristic 2
record.statement:
Conjecture: Let $k$ be a global function field with $\\operatorname{char}(k)=2$. Then every affine algebraic $k$-group scheme has finite class numbers; that is, for every finite set $S$ of places of $k$ and every compact open subgroup $K\subset G(\mathbb A_k^S)$, the double-coset space
\[
G(k)\backslash G(\mathbb A_k)/G(k_S)K
\]
is finite.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/35](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/2046), page 10. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Adelic version of a conjecture of Tate for Shimura varieties
record.statement: For every point $y:\operatorname{Spec}(F)\to N$, each tensor $t_\alpha$ ($\alpha\in J$) is the crystalline realization of an algebraic cycle on the abelian variety $A$ associated with $y$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/35](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/2046), page 38. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Permanence of the Bost conjecture under open subgroups
record.statement: Let $G$ be a locally compact second countable Hausdorff group. If the Bost conjecture is true for $G$ and arbitrary separable $C^*$-coefficients, then the same is true for all open subgroups of $G$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/37](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/2048), page 30. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Permanence of the Bost conjecture under passage to closed subgroups
record.statement: Let $G$ be a locally compact second countable Hausdorff group and let $H$ be a closed subgroup of $G$. If the Bost conjecture with arbitrary separable $C^*$-algebra coefficients is true for $G$, must it also be true for $H$?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/37](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/2048), page 30. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Invariance of the Bost conjecture under equivalent groupoids
record.statement: Let $G$ and $H$ be locally compact Hausdorff groupoids admitting Haar systems and having $\c3$-compact unit spaces. If $G$ and $H$ are equivalent, then the Bost conjecture with arbitrary $C^*$-coefficients is true for $G$ if and only if it is true for $H$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/37](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/2048), page 31. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Fiberwise KK-equivalence of continuous fields of C*-algebras
record.statement:
Let $A$ and $B$ be separable nuclear continuous $C(X)$-algebras over a finite-dimensional compact metrizable space $X$. If $\sigma \in KK_X(A,B)$, then
\[
\sigma \in KK_X(A,B)^{-1}\quad\text{if and only if}\quad \sigma_x \in KK(A(x),B(x))^{-1}\ \text{for all }x\in X.
\]
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/37](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/2048), page 40. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: K1-injectivity of unital properly infinite C*-algebras
record.statement: Is every unital properly infinite C*-algebra K1-injective; equivalently, is the canonical map $U(A)/U_0(A)\to K_1(A)$ injective for every unital properly infinite C*-algebra $A$?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/37](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/2048), page 57. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Global generation of direct images of relative pluricanonical bundles
record.statement: **Conjecture 3.** Let $f:X\to Y$ be an algebraic fiber space, i.e. $X$ and $Y$ are smooth projective varieties and $f$ is surjective with connected fibers. Then, for every sufficiently large integer $m$, the sheaf $f_*\mathcal{O}_X(mK_{X/Y})$ is globally generated outside the discriminant locus of $f$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/38](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/2049), page 43. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Strong Tits Alternative
record.statement: For every $d\in\mathbb{N}$ there is $N=N(d)\in\mathbb{N}$ such that, if $K$ is any field and $F$ is a finite symmetric subset of $GL_d(K)$ containing $1$, then either the product set $F^N=F\cdot\ldots\cdot F$ contains two elements which freely generate a nonabelian free group, or the group generated by $F$ is virtually solvable, i.e. contains a solvable subgroup of finite index.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/42](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/2053), page 39. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Almost-everywhere strong Diophantine condition for pairs in $SU(2)$
record.statement:
For almost every pair $(a,b)\in SU(2,\mathbb{R})$, there exists a constant $C(a,b)>0$ such that
\[
d\bigl(w(a,b),1\bigr)\ge \exp\bigl(-C(a,b)\,\ell(w)\bigr)
\]
for every nontrivial word $w\in F_2$, where $d$ is a Riemannian distance on $GL_2(\mathbb{C})$ and $\ell(w)$ is the word length. The report attributes this conjecture to Sarnak.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/42](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/2053), page 42. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Borel nature of the self-similarity group of a measurable flow
record.statement: For a measurable flow $T=(T_t)_{t\in\mathbb{R}}$, define $I(T)=\{s\in\mathbb{R}\setminus\{0\}:T\text{ and }T_s=(T_{st})_{t\in\mathbb{R}}\text{ are isomorphic}\}$. Is $I(T)$ a Borel group for every measurable flow $T$?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/42](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/2053), page 48. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Finite width conjecture for the lower central series of a group acting on a building
record.statement: Conjecture: Let $G$) be the group described in the report and let $G=\gamma_0(G)\geq\gamma_1(G)\geq\gamma_2(G)\geq\cdots$ denote its lower central series, with $\gamma_{i+1}(G)=[\gamma_i(G),G]$. Then, for every $i\geq 2$, $$[\gamma_i(G):\gamma_{i+1}(G)]=\begin{cases}8,&i\equiv 0,1\pmod 3,\\4,&i\equiv 2\pmod 3.\end{cases}$$ Equivalently, the group $G$ has finite width $3$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/42](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/2053), page 55. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Kropholler’s fixed-point question
record.statement: Does there exist a countably infinite group $G$ for which every finite-dimensional contractible $G$-CW-complex has a global fixed point?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/43](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/2089), page 12. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Unbounded strong realization conjecture
record.statement: Let $X$ be a topological space, and regard $H^*(X;\mathbb F_2)$ as an unstable module over the mod-$2$ Steenrod algebra. If $H^*(X;\mathbb F_2)\notin U_0$, then there exists an integer $s\ge 0$ such that, for every integer $n\ge 0$, $\operatorname{Nil}_s H^*(X;\mathbb F_2)/\operatorname{Nil}_{s+1}H^*(X;\mathbb F_2)\notin U_n$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/43](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/2089), page 31. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Gordon’s exceptional Dehn filling conjecture
record.statement: For any hyperbolic knot manifold $M$, we have $\#E(M)\le 10$ and $\Delta(E(M))\le 8$. Moreover, if $M\neq M_1,M_2,M_3,M_4$, then $\#E(M)\le 7$ and $\Delta(E(M))\le 5$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/43](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/2089), page 41. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Ellipse characterization from the Type 4 geometric-permutation property
record.statement: Let $K$ be a centrally symmetric oval in $\mathbb{R}^2$ with smooth boundary, and suppose that $K$ does not admit Type $4$; equivalently, no finite family of pairwise disjoint translates of $K$ has both geometric permutations $1234$ and $2413$. Must $K$ be an ellipse? The report notes that this is considered unlikely, even if strict convexity is additionally assumed.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/44](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/2090), page 26. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Union complexity of three-dimensional cigars of arbitrary radii
record.statement: For a collection of $n$ cigars in $\[3$-space—where a cigar is the Minkowski sum of a line segment and a ball, and the cigars may have arbitrary radii—the report states that the combinatorial complexity of their union is nearly quadratic.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/44](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/2090), page 28. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Undecidability of PL embeddability in codimension one
record.statement: For every fixed integer $d\ge 5$, the decision problem whose input is a finite simplicial complex $K$ of dimension at most $d-1$ and whose output is YES exactly when $K$ admits a piecewise-linear embedding into $\mathbb{R}^d$ is algorithmically undecidable; equivalently, $\mathrm{EMBED}_{d-1\to d}$ is algorithmically undecidable.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/44](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/2090), page 30. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Schmidt conjecture for lattice points on smooth convex surfaces
record.statement:
For every integer dimension $d\ge 3$ and every compact smooth convex surface $\partial K\subset\mathbb{R}^d$ with everywhere non-vanishing Gaussian curvature, one has
\[
\#\bigl(\mathbb{Z}^d\cap R\partial K\bigr)\lesssim R^{d-2}
\]
for dilations $R\to\infty$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/44](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/2090), page 42. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Equality of translative and lattice packing densities
record.statement: Is it true that $\delta(K)=\delta^*(K)$ for every convex body $K$?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/44](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/2090), page 61. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Universal optimality of the 40-point and 64-point spherical codes
record.statement: Prove that the two candidate configurations found in the reported search—one with 40 points in $\mathbb{R}^{10}$ and one with 64 points in $\mathbb{R}^{14}$—are examples of previously unknown universally optimal spherical codes.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/44](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/2090), page 63. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Extension of the isolated-transversal theorem to disjoint convex sets
record.statement: Can the local Helly-type result for an isolated line transversal be generalized to arbitrary collections of disjoint convex sets in $\mathbb{R}^d$?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/44](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/2090), page 65. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Representing finite projective planes by convex sets
record.statement: Does there exist a universal constant $d_0$ such that every finite projective plane, considered as a set system $(X,\mathcal F)$, is $d_0$-representable; that is, there are convex sets $C_x\subseteq\mathbb{R}^{d_0}$ for $x\in X$ such that, for every $I\subseteq X$, $\bigcap_{x\in I}C_x\neq\varnothing$ if and only if $I$ is contained in some $F\in\mathcal F$?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/44](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/2090), page 73. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Toric-residue derivatives of stable rational A-hypergeometric functions
record.statement: Conjecture 5.9 in [5] asserts that a suitable derivative of every stable rational A-hypergeometric function is a constant multiple of an explicit toric residue. The report states that this conjecture is proved for all codimension-two configurations A.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/45](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/2091), page 29. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Allcock’s monstrous proposal for a complex hyperbolic braid-group quotient
record.statement: Let $G=\pi_1^{\mathrm{orb}}(X_0)$, where $X_0=(B^{13}\setminus H)/\Gamma$, $H$ is the union of the mirrors of the triflections, and $\Delta=H/\Gamma$. The quotient obtained from $G$ by requiring a loop around $\Delta$ to have order $2$ is conjectured to be the bimonster $(M\times M):2$, where $M$ is the monster simple group.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/45](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/2091), page 30. Canonicalized from 3 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Van Hamme’s p-adic supercongruence (0.2)
record.statement:
For every prime $p>2$,
\[
\sum_{n=0}^{p-1}\frac{\left(\tfrac12\right)_n^3}{n!^3}(4n+1)(-1)^n\equiv \left(\frac{-1}{p}\right)p\pmod{p^3},
\]
where $(a)_n$ is the Pochhammer symbol and $\left(\frac{\cdot}{p}\right)$ denotes the Legendre symbol.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/45](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/2091), page 36. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Jordan boundaries of bounded Fatou components for polynomials
record.statement: For every polynomial $f$, every bounded Fatou component of $f$ is a Jordan domain.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/48](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/2094), page 7. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Conformal-radius upper bound for degree-\d polynomials
record.statement:
For $d\ge 3$, there exists $C=C(d)\in\mathbb{R}$ such that, for every polynomial $f$ of degree $d$ with an indifferent fixed point at the origin,
\[
\log \operatorname{rad}(f)\le -\frac{1}{d-1}B(\theta)+\log\min_i|c_i|+C,
\]
where the $c_i$ are the critical points of $f$ and $\theta$ is the rotation number at the origin.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/48](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/2094), page 14. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Dynamic-ray connectivity for escaping points of transcendental entire functions
record.statement: For every transcendental entire function $f$, can every escaping point $z\in I(f)$, where $I(f)=\{z\in\mathbb{C}: f^n(z)\to\infty\text{ as }n\to\infty\}$, be connected to $\infty$ by a curve consisting entirely of escaping points?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/48](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/2094), page 35. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Goemans’ convex-combination conjecture for single-source unsplittable flows
record.statement: Any flow $x$ satisfying demands $d$ can be written as a convex combination of unsplittable flows $y^{\ell}$, $\ell\in L$, each satisfying demands $d$ and such that $y^{\ell}_e\le x_e+d_{\max}$ for every $e\in E$, where $d_{\max}=\max_i d_i$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/51](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/2489), page 15. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Face containment of the quadratic linear ordering polytope
record.statement: For all $i<j<k$, the constraint $x_{ik}-y_{ijik}-y_{ikjk}+y_{ijjk}=0$ induces a face of the polytope $P_n$. In particular, $QLO(n)$ is a face of $P_n$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/51](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/2489), page 62. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Relevance of disorder at marginality in pinning models
record.statement:
For the generalized pinning model with 
\(\alpha=1/2\), equivalently \(K(n)\mathop{\sim}_{n\to\infty} Cn^{-3/2}\) for some \(C>0\), disorder is relevant at marginality: \(h_c(\beta)-h_c^a(\beta)>0\) for every \(\beta>0\). Moreover, there exists \(c>0\) such that
\[
h_c(\beta)-h_c^a(\beta)\ge \exp(-c/\beta^4),\qquad \beta\le 1.
\]
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/55](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/2493), page 31. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Existence of monotone fronts in convex FPU-type chains
record.statement: For all convex and twice continuously differentiable potentials \(\Phi:\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}\), the following assertions hold: (1) each front in the chain corresponds to a conservative shock in the \(p\)-system; (2) for each supersonic conservative shock in the \(p\)-system, there exists a corresponding monotone front in the chain.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/57](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/2495), page 38. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Invariant torus for the toy problem with essential spectrum up to the imaginary axis
record.statement:
For the toy problem (1)–(2) described on the source pages, with spatial variable in \(\mathbb{R}^d\), if \(d\ge 5\), then there exists \(\alpha _0>0\) such that, for every \(\alpha\in(0,\alpha _0)\), the flow has a two-dimensional invariant torus
\[
M=\{(r,U)=(r,U)(\phi):\phi\in\mathbb{T}^2\}
\]
of size \(O(\sqrt{\alpha})\).
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/57](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/2495), page 49. Canonicalized from 3 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Neighborly triangulations of the 3-torus with unbounded vertex-transitive symmetry
record.statement: Does there exist an unbounded number of neighborly triangulations of the 3-torus with vertex-transitive \(\mathbb Z_n\)-symmetry, for \(n\ge 15\), where “neighborly” means that any two vertices are joined by an edge?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2009/02](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/3385), page 40. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Bang-bang structure in the Robin parabolic boundary-control example
record.statement: For the Robin boundary-control problem (1)–(3) described in the report, with $T=1.58$, $\b1=1$, and $y_d(x)=\frac{1}{2}(1-x^2)$, the report proves that the optimal control is bang-bang with exactly one switching point $\bar{\tau}\in(1.329,1.3294)$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2009/04](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/3387), page 78. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Theorem 2: Fully Hilbertian function fields
record.statement: Let $K$ be an arbitrary field and let $F/K$ be a finitely generated transcendental extension. Then $F$ is fully Hilbertian.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2009/05](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/3388), page 16. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Non-Integrality Conjecture NIC_n
record.statement:
For every integer $n\ge 2$, if $V\subseteq \mathbb A^n$ is a hypersurface defined over $\mathbb Q$ such that $V(\mathbb Q)$ is Zariski dense, then
\[
V(\mathbb Q)\cap\bigl((\mathbb Q\setminus\mathbb Z)\times\mathbb Q^{n-1}\bigr)
\]
is Zariski dense.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2009/05](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/3388), page 25. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Period–index bounds for central simple algebras
record.statement: For a field $F$, does there exist an integer $n$ depending only on $F$ such that, for every central simple algebra $A$ over $F$, $\operatorname{ind}(A)\mid \operatorname{per}(A)^n$?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2009/05](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/3388), page 27. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Elliptic curves of rank zero over number fields
record.statement: For every number field $K$, does there exist an elliptic curve $E/K$ such that $\operatorname{rank}(E(K))=0$?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2009/05](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/3388), page 33. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Pólya’s conjecture for Dirichlet eigenvalues on planar domains
record.statement:
Let $\Omega\subset\mathbb{R}^{2}$ be a domain of finite measure, and let $\lambda_{n}^{\Omega}$ be the $n$-th Dirichlet-Laplacian eigenvalue on $\Omega$, counted with multiplicity. Is it true, without assuming that $\Omega$ is tiling, that
\[
\lambda_{n}^{\Omega}\geq \frac{4\pi}{|\Omega|}\,n
\quad\text{for every }n\in\mathbb{N}?
\]
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2009/06](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/3389), page 7. Canonicalized from 3 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Eigenvalue bounds for complex Schrödinger operators
record.statement:
Let $d\ge 2$ and let $\gamma>0$ be given. Is there a positive constant $C$ such that
\[
|\lambda|^\gamma\le C\int_{\mathbb{R}^d}|V(x)|^{d/2+\gamma}\,dx,
\]
for every complex-valued potential $V\in C_0^\infty(\mathbb{R}^d)$ and every eigenvalue $\lambda\notin\mathbb{R}_+=[0,\infty)$ of the operator $-\Delta+V$?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2009/06](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/3389), page 35. Canonicalized from 3 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Payne–Pólya–Weinberger-type bound for doubled Dirichlet eigenvalue indices
record.statement:
For an arbitrary bounded domain \(\Omega\subset\mathbb{R}^n\), prove that, for all \(m\),
\[
\frac{\lambda_{2m}}{\lambda_m}(\Omega)\leq \frac{\lambda_2}{\lambda_1}(\text{ball in }\mathbb{R}^n).
\]
Here \(\lambda_j\) denotes the \(j\)-th Dirichlet eigenvalue of the Laplacian on \(\Omega\).
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2009/06](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/3389), page 46. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Stokes conjecture for irrotational extreme water waves
record.statement:
For irrotational travelling water waves 
\((\gamma\equiv 0)\), the profile of any extreme wave has corners with included angle \(120^\circ\) at stagnation points.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2009/07](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/3390), page 25. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Choice of the expansion point in rational Krylov/Laguerre model reduction
record.statement: Choose the expansion point in rational Krylov-subspace model reduction so as to obtain a good approximation of the system’s response to arbitrary input signals. The report reformulates this as choosing the free Laguerre parameter $\alpha$ in the time-domain reduction method.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2009/11](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/3394), page 45. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Pisot Substitution Conjecture I
record.statement: **Pisot Substitution Conjecture I.** \(\Lambda\) is a regular model set with windows \(W\) (up to boundary points of the sets \(W_i\)), meaning that \(\Lambda_i=\Lambda_G(W_i)\) for all \(i\), up to points arising from the boundary of \(W_i\).
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2009/13](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/3396), page 17. Canonicalized from 3 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Pointwise finiteness of the shrinking-target exponent for uniquely ergodic IETs
record.statement:
Let $J=[0,1)=\mathbb{R}/\mathbb{Z}$, let $T:J\to J$ be an interval exchange transformation, and define
$$
\phi_1(x,y)=\liminf_{n\to\infty} n\,\langle T^n(x)-y\rangle,
$$
where $\langle a\rangle=\min_{k\in\mathbb{Z}}|a-k|$. If $T$ is uniquely ergodic, must $\phi_1(x,y)<\infty$ hold for every $x,y\in J$?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2009/13](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/3396), page 24. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Equality of the two characteristic-cycle constructions
record.statement:
Assume that $n>2$ and that $c\in\mathbb{C}\setminus\mathbb{Q}_{<0}$. Then, for every finitely generated $U_c$-module $M$, one has an equality of algebraic cycles
\[
\operatorname{ch}_{GS}(M)=\operatorname{ch}_{GG}(M).
\]
